```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: 📥 Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 🛠️ Set up Node.js 18
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18
          cache: npm

      - name: 📦 Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: 🚀 Build production
        run: npm run build --if-present
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production

      - name: ✅ Validate build outputs
        run: |
          echo "🔍 Checking build artifacts..."
          if [ ! -d dist ]; then
            echo "❌ dist directory missing"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$(ls -A dist)" ]; then
            echo "❌ dist directory is empty"
            exit 1
          fi
          for file in dist/*; do
            if [ ! -s "$file" ]; then
              echo "❌ $file is empty"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "✅ All build artifacts are present and non‑empty"

      - name: 📦 Zip build artifacts
        run: |
          echo "📦 Creating dist.zip..."
          zip -r dist.zip dist
          echo "✅ dist.zip created"

      - name: 🏷️ Generate release tag
        id: tag
        run: |
          TAG="v$(date +'%Y.%m.%d-%H%M%S')"
          echo "Generated tag: $TAG"
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "TAG=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: 📤 Create GitHub Release
        id: create_release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }}
          name: Release ${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }}
          body: |
            Automated release generated on ${{ github.event.head_commit.timestamp }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: 📤 Upload release asset
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: ./dist.zip
          asset_name: dist.zip
          asset_content_type: application/zip

      - name: 🎉 Release complete
        run: echo "✅ Release ${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }} created successfully!"
```
